fieldValues.title: Change in Semantic engineering in practice
fieldValues.summary: Change or stability: integrating new ideas (Disrupt) vs refining what we are doing now (Stabilise). The owner's localisation of the classic axis (vignette 'Evolving the axes', 2026-10-24). The poles are the classic poles, which the owner affirmed on 2026-10-22; yang is the classic yang. For the owner to judge in relation.
